$comment: schema_version 1.x (v1); tracks design/spec/features/NF-024-028-inspect-interop.md §4.2. Additive/optional capsule facet stored under extensions/dev.novafabric.dataset-provenance/. Does not modify run-capsule.schema.json.
title: DatasetProvenanceFacet
description: Additive/optional (NF-028). Records the dataset + split content hashes an eval ran against so a capsule can be flagged when it was run on a contaminated or superseded benchmark version. Detection/flagging only — no remediation. Absence of the facet ⇒ contamination status 'unknown'.

version.description: Dataset version/tag, e.g. '2024-06' or a release id.

dataset_hash.description: Content hash of the dataset (never the dataset bytes — SPK-HARN-4).

split_hash.description: Content hash of the specific split the eval consumed.

status.description: Contamination/staleness flag. 'contaminated'/'superseded' set an audit flag; 'current' is clean; 'unknown' when no registry match is available.
